name: Val-de-Grace
aka: Ancienne abbaye du Val-de-Grâce, puis hôpital militaire

dates.built: 1623-1666 (the span of the campaign years the Mérimée notice prints)
dates.altered: The abbey became a military hospital after the Revolution; fr.wikipedia records that 'le règlement du 30 floréal an IV (19 mai 1796) la transforme en hôpital d'instruction' and that the hospital moved out of the conventual buildings into a new building by André Chatelin in 1979.
dates.note: The Mérimée notice prints 'Année(s) de(s) campagne(s) de construction 1623 ; 1645 ; 1655 ; 1666' and states no single build date. 1645 is the year usually given for the church, and the notice does not say so.

refs.title: Ancienne abbaye du Val-de-Grâce, puis hôpital militaire
refs.note: The notice prints 'Nature de la protection de l'édifice classé MH partiellement' and names six authors. The reference was read from the fr.wikipedia list of monuments historiques of the 5th arrondissement, which prints 'Abbaye du Val-de-Grâce | place Alphonse-Laveran | « PA00088392 » | Classé | 1964 1990'.

refs.title: Pavillon sud bordant la cour d'honneur de l'église du Val-de-Grâce
refs.note: A second, separate listing for the south pavilion of the church's cour d'honneur, classed 1996; read from the same list page and carried as a locator only.

refs.title: Hôpital d'instruction des armées du Val-de-Grâce — Wikipédia
refs.note: Read for the later history; it states the abbey 'comprend aujourd'hui l'église Notre-Dame du Val-de-Grâce (conçue par François Mansart et réalisée par Jacques Lemercier)'.

survey.prepared: The notice prints 'Date de rédaction de la notice 1992' and its legal note is signed '© Monuments historiques, 1992'.

note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026. Carried for this node because the corpus's own account of the Dôme des Invalides places it at the end of a Parisian sequence of domed churches, and the Val-de-Grâce is the middle term. The register states four campaign years, six names and no architecture: no material, no dimension, no order, no dome diameter. No rights line was read, so no `rights_evidence`.
